steps.say: Winnipeg Parcel Search has two parcel fabrics. Assessment parcels come from the City's assessment roll. Survey parcels are the legal lots. Each has a results layer and an all-parcels layer.
Zoning cycles through three states. Shaded colours every parcel by zone with a legend. Labels prints the zone codes. A third click turns it off.
Neighbourhoods also cycles: first the 23 neighbourhood clusters, then the 235 individual neighbourhoods. Click any polygon to see its name and cluster.
The basemap menu has the City's aerial photography for 2016, 2018, 2021, 2024 and 2026, plus satellite. Flip between years to see when a building appeared.
Dimensions shows survey lengths once you are zoomed in past level 17. They are from the survey parcel, so they may not match the assessment parcel exactly.

Planning holds the secondary plans, the infill area, malls and corridors, and the airport vicinity area. The Zoning Changes pill marks parcels with a recent D M I S zoning amendment, and Filter keeps only those.
Reference adds 24 hour traffic counts, environmentally tracked sites, transit, dwelling units, current street names and water influence.

Historical overlays an earlier snapshot of the whole city. Pick a date and press Historical. Earlier assessment parcels appear in dashed amber, tinted by how much their size changed, and survey lots in violet.
Measure, at the top right of the map, gives distance or area by clicking points and double-clicking to finish.
Data Status reports when the parcel tiles, the historical archive and each live City service were last updated. A banner appears at the top of the page if the tiles fall more than sixty days behind.
